nextMilestone helper (web L15-19): ported verbatim — const step = 10_000; return Math.ceil((totalMi + 1) / step) * step; (the JSDoc '/** Round up to the next 10 000-mile milestone above current total. */' is kept verbatim).

String(id) : '') destructured 1:1 as data/isLoading/error/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch. The native useMileageStats requests /mileage/stats?vehicle_id={id} verbatim (request() auto-prefixes /api/v1) and is disabled when vehicleId is '' (enabled: !!vehicleId), preserving the web id<=0 -> empty-string short-circuit exactly.

Unit derivations (web L29-32): const { unitPrefs } = useUnits(); toDistanceDisplay = value => convertDistanceFromSI(value, unitPrefs.distance); distanceUnit = unitPrefs.distance. The scoped native useUnits() reads web-parity useSettings(): unitPrefs.distance from unit_of_length ('mi'->'mi' else 'km', mirroring web deriveDistance) and unitPrefs.locale from settings.locale (deriveLocale, en-US fallback). convertDistanceFromSI(meters,'km')=meters/1000 and (…,'mi')=meters/1609.344 reproduce the web @/lib/unitConversion METERS_PER_KM=1000 / METERS_PER_MILE=1609.344 (NIST exact) factors verbatim; only the 'km'|'mi' arms deriveDistance can yield are implemented.

SI->display derivations (web L36-49): totalMeters = (data?.lifetime_km ?? 0) * 1000; dailyAvgMeters = ((data?.last_30d_km ?? 0) / 30) * 1000; totalDisplay = toDistanceDisplay(totalMeters); dailyAvgDisplay = toDistanceDisplay(dailyAvgMeters); milestone = nextMilestone(totalDisplay); remaining = milestone - totalDisplay; monthsToMilestone = dailyAvgDisplay > 0 ? Math.max(1, Math.round(remaining / dailyAvgDisplay / 30)) : 0 — ported verbatim, including the *1000 SI-km->m hoist and the /30 last_30d_km rolling-window daily average. The source comment block (L36-40) explaining the *1000 hoist + last_30d_km vs legacy avgDaily is preserved verbatim above the math.
